integer_budget_handling: Report both floor and ceiling of fraction times Table 2 maximum N, each with minimum 1; retain both interpretations when distinct. These are nominal historical budgets, not claims of equal wall time on current hardware.
ranking_scope: Report pooled controls and each of the three fixed-mean-rate strata. Do not select the aggregation yielding the closest published value; the author aggregation is not recovered.
rankings: Rank each policy by its objective, with average ranks for exact ties as primary and stable policy-ID tie breaking as sensitivity. Compute both linear and quadratic weighted kappa from paired rank vectors and their empirical marginal distributions.
reference: Existing full-size seeds 1..50; independent full-size comparison seeds 101..150. Never use an identical reference as the full-size experimental point.
limits: Common seeds couple policies. No original outer replication count or uncertainty-bar construction has been recovered; reconstructed point estimates alone do not reproduce Figure 10 error bars.
